events.content:
The dashboard now pre-renders its heading and placeholders for the revenue and invoice panels. The dashboard fetch runs inside a Suspense boundary at request time, so it no longer blocks the shell.

I aligned the project with Next.js 16.4.5 and enabled partial prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts). The shared placeholders are in [DashboardSkeleton.tsx](/workspace/app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx).

`npm run build` passes and reports `/` as a partial pre-rendered route. I also checked that the generated HTML contains the heading and all panel placeholders. The data panels still require a working API endpoint; the existing `api.example.com` URL is a placeholder.
